founderAnswers.topic: How the T008 units are launched
founderAnswers.terms: Unchanged: a root launcher with a T008 mode starts the driver as braidlab in its own Background session (launchctl asuser). The orchestrator runs its check automatically (passwordless sudo rule for check only); the owner runs `sudo ... run` in Terminal.app with the password and types the quota readings.
The founder issued the 2026-11-14 records on the terms of 2026-11-13. This is the basis for moving the T008-6 binding; it is a SPEC-065 answer, not a new SPEC-048/T008 answer.
